title: How a Washing Machine Works in 60 Seconds 🧺🌀 #shorts
description:
A washing machine is a spinning drum, a motor, a pump and a few valves working together. Water and detergent fill the tub, paddles lift and drop your clothes to scrub out dirt, a pump drains and rinses, and a final spin of up to 1,200 rpm flings the water out through tiny holes. Fill, tumble, rinse, spin. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#washingmachine #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Drum
steps.text: Your washing machine's drum can spin over *a thousand* times a minute.

steps.label: Fill
steps.text: First, a *valve* opens and water fills the tub, mixing with the detergent.

steps.label: Tumble
steps.text: Paddles inside the drum *lift* your clothes and drop them, again and again, knocking out dirt.

steps.label: The Motor
steps.text: An electric *motor* drives the drum, turning it one way, then the other.

steps.label: Drain & Rinse
steps.text: A *pump* drains the dirty water. Then fresh water rinses out the soap.

steps.label: Spin
steps.text: Finally the drum *spins* up to 1,200 times a minute, flinging water out through tiny holes.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Fill, tumble, rinse, *spin*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
